# MezonHook

MezonHook is a static React/Vite dual-mode composer. Channel Webhook mode uses a strict version 3 project for direct delivery. Bot SDK mode uses a strict version 2 project and generates an authenticated JavaScript sender. The modes keep independent local drafts and imports route by version.

## Public app

- URL: https://mezonhook.dungxbuif.com/
- User guide: docs/USAGE.md
- Live evidence and support matrix: docs/LIVE-VERIFICATION.md
- Deployment: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md

## Modes

- Channel Webhook v3: ordered `t`, `mk`, `mentions`, `images`, and `hg`; raw JSON/cURL; named targets; browser delivery.
- Bot SDK v2: ordered content, embeds, fields, buttons, input/select/radio/date/animation payloads; full generated JavaScript using environment credentials. Interaction handlers are intentionally not generated.

## Supported Channel Webhook envelope

```json
{
  "type": "hook",
  "message": {
    "t": "required text",
    "mk": [{ "type": "pre or lk", "s": 0, "e": 1 }],
    "mentions": [{ "user_id": "or username, exactly one", "s": 0, "e": 1 }],
    "images": [{ "fn": "file.png", "sz": 1, "url": "https://...", "ft": "image/png", "w": 1, "h": 1 }],
    "hg": [{ "channelId": "channel ID", "s": 0, "e": 1 }]
  }
}
```

Ranges are zero-based, start-inclusive, end-exclusive, and must remain inside `t`. Unknown or mistyped fields are rejected.

## Important boundaries

- Fresh webhook projects use a meaningful rich demo that exposes every supported field; its mention/channel IDs are illustrative. Stored and imported values are preserved.
- Desktop uses natural document scrolling. A preview is sticky below the header only while its full content fits the remaining viewport; oversized previews use normal flow without nested scrolling. Layouts at or below 1000px use Compose/Preview tabs and normal pane flow.
- Both preview modes use scoped Mezon-like conversation styling; it does not leak into editor controls.
- Webhook URLs are memory-only secrets and are excluded from storage and exports.
- The webhook and Bot projects use separate storage keys. Invalid stored JSON is left untouched rather than silently overwritten.
- Import routes v2 to Bot SDK and v3 to Channel Webhook; export saves only the active mode.
- Generated Bot SDK code reads `MEZON_BOT_ID`, `MEZON_BOT_TOKEN`, and `MEZON_CHANNEL_ID` and preserves message order.
- Clipboard feedback never claims success after both native and fallback copy methods fail.
- Bot-only embed, button, input, select, radio, and date-picker rendering was visually verified. Interaction handlers were not registered in the audit bot. Animation remains unverified.
- Node.js 20–23 is supported for local verification; Node.js 24 is excluded because of the current Mezon SDK development dependency.

## Verification commands

```bash
npm test
npm run build --workspace @mezonhook/web
npm run verify:live -- --mode=dry-run
```
